$comment: CLM-0628 · CLM-0630 · RISK-0068 — files whose runtime code calls the file system or names a path outside its package.

Read by scripts/deploy/render_plan.py (reads → deploy inputs of every service whose closure contains the file; `unresolved` → those services always deploy) and audited by scripts/deploy/runtime_reads.py via scripts/checks/validate-render-deploy-plan.sh.

`calls` is the measured fingerprint `fn(<argument text>) → <resolved target>`; any change fails the audit until re-reviewed. Policy: runtime-input equivalence, not image-byte equivalence (the image is COPY . .).
